source.paraphrase: Managed components must resolve collaborators through the injected kernel instead of constructing them directly.

invariants.why: Managed components must resolve collaborators through the injected kernel instead of constructing them directly.
invariants.fixHint: Register at the composition root and use dependencies.resolve or resolveSingleton. Direct root construction in an inline addFactoryMethod is allowed.
invariants.avoid: Identifies the first inline arrow/function creator argument through literal dot/bracket/template members, optional calls, comments and parenthesized/as/satisfies/non-null wrappers. Also follows an immutable const initialized with an arrow/function expression when its direct first-argument reference follows initialization in the same lexical scope. A direct call of that name in the same scope, a declaration export or a local named/default value export removes the root exception. Type-only exports and foreign re-exports do not export the local creator; nested calls, other escapes and full call-graph ownership remain unresolved. Extra callbacks and leading spreads do not establish ownership. Strict policy over selected paths, including local classes; scope out value-only modules deliberately. Exclusive ownership of declared/exported creators, aliases, mutable/cross-scope/imported creators, dynamic/escaped names, generators, type assertions, indirect values and returned-constructor value wrappers remain unresolved.

source.paraphrase: Managed components must receive the kernel; they must not import the global dcouplr runtime.

invariants.why: Managed components must receive the kernel; they must not import the global dcouplr runtime.
invariants.fixHint: Pass the injected IDKernel from addFactoryMethod. Initialize the runtime at the composition boundary.
invariants.avoid: Value named imports, including renamed imports, and direct namespace dot/bracket references and object destructuring are checked. Type-only imports, unrelated namespaces and lexical shadowing are admitted. Namespace aliases, computed members, dynamic/CommonJS imports and re-export barrels still need data-flow/import-graph coverage; nested-block var hoisting remains conservative.
